info.title: Tronicare Actions API
info.description: Source-derived HTTP contract for the actions api process. Mutation routes return 503 while mutations are disabled or write authority is unavailable. JSON records preserve legacy member spelling and signed 64-bit integer values. Unknown JSON members are ignored, but duplicate keys, non-finite numbers and invalid UTF-8 are rejected. Request bodies are limited to 1,048,576 bytes. This offline document does not enable a runtime /openapi.json or interactive docs endpoint.

servers.description: The selected actions api listener; configure the deployment base URL.

get.description: Returns 200 when ready and 503 when unavailable. API dependency checks time out after five seconds.

503.description: Process or dependencies are not ready.

get.description: Requires entity actions right r. Returns a raw array ordered by primary key.  The shared handler also accepts the implicit entity_id query parameter; GET then returns one record and skips collection filters. The Redis method-right gate is supplemented by bounded caller-token Users /v1/usersadmin/context checks of current SQL identity, organization, role, group memberships and method rights. Stale or malformed policy state fails closed. Platform level is 90 or above; configured internal credentials do not inherit business-entity rights. Ordinary instance access is limited to the complete Assets /v1/assets/scope grants for the caller organization. An empty grant set never selects global instances or history. Readable shared templates are preserved.

parameters.name: entity_id
parameters.description: Implicit FastAPI query argument from the shared handler. If supplied to GET, this reads one record instead of listing; collection filters are ignored. POST validates this value but still creates a new record with a generated ID. Repeated entity_id values use the last value. Positive integer at most 9223372036854775807.

parameters.name: idrule
parameters.description: Filter by rule. Signed 64-bit decimal integer; empty means omitted. Repeated values are rejected. The numeric value must be between -9223372036854775808 and 9223372036854775807.

parameters.name: istemplate
parameters.description: Filter by the template flag. Accepts 0, 1, true or false (case-insensitive); empty means omitted. Repeated values are rejected.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Legacy list bound. Missing, empty or zero uses 50. At most max(1, limit + 1) rows are returned, so the default can return 51. Negative values are accepted. Repeated values are rejected.

post.description: Requires entity actions right c. Requires enabled mutations and authoritative write state. Returns the created record with HTTP 200 and a generated primary key.  The shared handler also accepts the implicit entity_id query parameter; GET then returns one record and skips collection filters. The Redis method-right gate is supplemented by bounded caller-token Users /v1/usersadmin/context checks of current SQL identity, organization, role, group memberships and method rights. Stale or malformed policy state fails closed. Platform level is 90 or above; configured internal credentials do not inherit business-entity rights. Ordinary instance access is limited to the complete Assets /v1/assets/scope grants for the caller organization. An empty grant set never selects global instances or history. Readable shared templates are preserved. Persisted one-time-password sessions cannot mutate. Dependency reads finish before the fenced database mutation; effective persisted-plus-submitted ownership and references are checked again under the row lock before state or audit changes. Templates may be created, edited, converted to instances or deleted only by platform administrators. Ordinary instance writes require a granted asset and valid same-asset authoritative Rules rule and its Core sensor, excluding template parents.

parameters.description: Only the literal 1 reverses primary-key ordering; every other value keeps ascending order. Repeated values are rejected.

get.description: Requires authentication. Missing, invalid or unauthenticated Token is represented by HTTP 200 with Status=false. Other authorization and dependency errors use the fault response. Service information requires current platform level 90 or above, or the configured trusted internal credential. Ordinary authenticated callers receive 403. Public heartbeat metrics retain their existing authentication contract.

ActionsRequest.description: All members are optional. POST uses defaults for omitted fields and generates the primary key. PUT merges supplied members into the existing record; a supplied primary key must match the path. Unknown members are ignored. Integer members accept JSON integers, not strings, booleans or decimal numbers.

Actions.description: Raw legacy wire record returned by the configured PostgreSQL store. Null database values are projected as zero, false, empty string, epoch or midnight according to field type.

Engine_Lastheartbeat.description: Seconds since the engine heartbeat; optional if unavailable.

AdminInfo.description: Authentication failure is an HTTP 200 object with Status=false and Error="bad authentication". Successful responses also include engine metadata.

ForwardBrief.description: Six count buckets: levels 1, 2, 3, each with isread=true followed by false.

TokenAuth.name: Token
TokenAuth.description: Exactly one Token header: 1 to 4096 printable ASCII characters in the range U+0021 through U+007E. No spaces. CRUD operations require authentication; entity permissions are documented per operation.

401.description: Authentication failed or invalid Token header.

409.description: Request conflicts with the current state.

503.description: Required dependency unavailable, timeout, disabled mutations or unavailable write authority.
